prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fully designed desktop web application Home screen for Mazi, signed-in shared memory archive for 8 friends. Landscape 1536x1024, straight-on screen capture, no device mockup or presentation annotations. This is an operational memory-browsing interface, never a marketing landing page. Persistent readable navigation: mazi / Home active / Timeline / Search / My Imports / one small group avatar. Synthetic photo content of friends: Mediterranean terrace dinner at dusk, rainy city walks, a lake swim, picnic and birthday table. Selected memory title exactly 'The night we missed the last ferry', metadata 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos · Added by Deniz', visible 'Open memory' action. Small 'Demo memories' label. Design must feel warm and human through large unfiltered full-color photography even where the surrounding system is abstract. No fake metrics, testimonials, public share/publish/privacy controls, likes, AI summaries, notifications, ornamental technology charts, microscopic necessary text, or generic rounded-card dashboard. Every control usable and beautifully spaced. Exceptionally ambitious bespoke studio-quality application design.
STRUCTURE AND WORLD: THE MEMORY GARDEN. Make an original sculptural 3D photographic place, inspired by the swelling color regions of a garden guide. Cream #F5F1E4 ground, huge clean apple-green #8ED462 organic landform filling center-right and bleeding off two edges, ink #2C2E2A heavy grotesk text, acid-yellow #F5E211 selection control and restrained coral #FF705D markers. Main landform is a shallow sculpted 3D ISLAND with a visible thick smooth edge and subtle self-shadow, no cartoon vegetation. Within its top surface an inset large sharply rectangular photograph of the friends at dinner is framed by a carved opening; photo itself readable and undistorted. Two smaller sculptural islands nearby hold other real photo surfaces, with titles beneath. Photography dominates the sculpture, not vice versa. A cream negative-space channel between forms establishes navigation and separation. Left upper area compact strong type 'Somewhere / we were / together.' with selected memory title and metadata below. Clear yellow pill 'Open memory' with dark arrow circle aligned left of island. A restrained ordinary memory list at bottom-left offers the exact same three choices with dates. Tiny label 'Memory view · not a map' clarifies that no actual geography is claimed. Stable HTML navigation above. High-end playful architectural model quality, no toy people, vegetation, planets, avatars-as-objects, decorative blobs covering content, gradients, translucent glass, or topographic data. One memorable dominant spatial composition, polished shadows and warm natural photos.
Keep all interface copy deliberate and typeset. No handwritten sentimental slogans or extra inspirational phrases.
